newsitem.title: UK: Argos shares ease, but results as expected.
newsitem.headline: Argos shares ease, but results as expected.

text.p: Shares in retailer Argos Plc eased 4-1/2 pence to 618-1/2 after the company reported an expected fall in first-half results.
"It's a reasonable set of figures. The reasons why the profit went down were well flagged," said BZW analyst Tony Shiret.
Pre-tax profit fell to 28.08 million stg, down from 31.80 million due to additional costs and the payment of a special dividend last year.
Argos said expected its markets to be slow in the second half of the year.
Higher interest rates might hurt consumer spending, the catalogue retailer said. The end to windfall gains stemming from building societies conversions could also dampen spending, it added.
